title: The Istrys
description:
Cubistry™ and its sibling 3D match 2 puzzle games dubbed the Istrys by fans are now in one place as "The Istrys™"! Start playing for free all your favorites and arrange them however you like to suit how you like to play. Create a Cubitopia™(coming soon) account to keep your scores across multiple platforms. Subscribe to Cubitopia™ to unlock new Istrys earlier, access exclusive content, level up using points from multiple games(More Cubitopia™ games are coming soon), remove ads, and more!



-Fun 3D match 2 puzzle game play with 17 singleplayer modes with more to come.

-Co-op and versus modes. 

-All your favorite Istrys in one place. (Not all Istrys are available yet but are coming soon.)

-Cross platform achievements and leaderboards with Cubitopia™(Coming soon).

-Premium features with a subscription to Cubitopia™(Coming soon).
description_short: Cubistry™ is now "The Istrys™"! Start playing for free Cubistry™ and its sibling 3D match 2 puzzle games dubbed the Istrys by fans in one place. Arrange the games to suit how you play and check back often since new Istrys are coming soon!
